pattern: (?:summer ends|season (?:closed|ended)) with a (?:poolside )?potluck|potluck by the water
struck: The summer ends with a potluck by the water.
use: In 2026 the Music and Moonlight evenings closed with a poolside potluck on September 26; the pool itself closed September 30 [Myrtle Trace newsletter, October 2026].

pattern: board has decided not to seek a change before|decided not to seek a change
struck: The board has decided not to seek a change before the covenants renew in 2033.
use: In 2026 the board voted 5 to 0 not to pursue a change now; the current ten-year period ends in 2033 [Myrtle Trace newsletter, October 2026].

pattern: (?<!\[)\bLocals knew the land as a ridge
struck: Locals knew the land as a ridge, and it stands about 40 feet above sea level.
use: The HOA's history calls the land a ridge that locals knew [HOA 40th anniversary paper, 2023, an unsigned typescript]; it stands about 42 feet above sea level [USGS].

struck: against about 14 feet at the oceanfront downtown.
use: against about 15 feet along the oceanfront downtown (7 to 17 feet within 100 meters) [USGS 3DEP].

pattern: bulkheads along the water\b(?! banks)|deep bunkers around raised greens
struck: It carries Dye's marks: wooden bulkheads along the water, deep bunkers around raised greens and fast greens.
use: It has several of Dye's marks [MyHorryNews, July 2025]: wooden bulkheads along many water banks, deep-faced bunkers around often-elevated greens and fast TifEagle greens.

pattern: owners association took over the large pool|clay courts need a tennis membership
struck: When the club ended its memberships, the owners association took over the large pool, a smaller pool and the tennis center, with eleven clay courts and two hard courts. The clay courts need a tennis membership of their own.
use: (In 2015 the club's owner offered to lease or convey the tennis and swim facilities to the owners association for $1 each [Club + Resort Business, 2015]. A 2016 report says the association purchased them, and also says a third-party operator ran the tennis club, with the pool and two hard courts open to residents and the 11 clay courts on a club membership [Club + Resort Business, February 2016]. Whether this still holds is not verified: state it as 2016, or cut it.)

pattern: Seasons lot backs onto TPC[^.]{0,40}across the road
struck: no Seasons lot backs onto TPC Myrtle Beach across the road.
use: The nearest Seasons lot is about 560 meters, a little over a third of a mile, from the TPC Myrtle Beach course [county parcels, OpenStreetMap].

struck: half-acre lots, and 14 that reach Collins Creek
use: half-acre lots, and 14 within 30 meters of Collins Creek [county parcels, USGS creek line]; only 3 touch the mapped creek line.

pattern: About 30 lots back onto a pond
struck: About 30 lots back onto a pond.
use: About 30 lots lie within 10 meters of a mapped pond [county parcels, OpenStreetMap].

struck: TPC Myrtle Beach, next to Bellwood Landing and Seasons, was given 5 stars by Golf Digest in 2008.
use: TPC Myrtle Beach was given 5 stars by Golf Digest in 2008 [club's account]. Its course is about 100 meters from the nearest Bellwood Landing lot and about 560 meters from the nearest Seasons lot.

pattern: Across the road is TPC Myrtle Beach
struck: Across the road is TPC Myrtle Beach, a Tom Fazio course that Golf Digest gave five stars in 2008.
use: TPC Myrtle Beach, a Tom Fazio course, lies about 100 meters from the nearest Bellwood Landing lot (a road between them is not confirmed).

struck: the Dustin Johnson World Junior Championship each spring (its ninth year in 2024, 90 players)
use: (cut it: the club says it began hosting in 2015 and the news post is undated, so 2024 is not supported; the page does not use it)
